testSuite.name: Fixed Preference Priority
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference takes precedence over manual review criteria

testSuite.name: High Rate Sensitivity Priority
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity takes precedence over other rules

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Success
testSuite.description: Meets all criteria for ARM 7/1 product assignment

testSuite.name: ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Meets ARM 7/1 criteria at the exact boundary values for horizon, LTV and credit score

testSuite.name: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI ratio above 50 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV ratio above 95 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: No Rule Match Scenario
testSuite.description: Case where no rules are satisfied (e.g., long horizon and normal credit/LTV)

testSuite.name: Rule 1 vs Rule 3 Conflict
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) should trigger before Rule 3 (ManualReview) due to FIRST hit policy

testSuite.name: Rule 2 vs Rule 3 Conflict
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails due to LTV being too high, so Rule 3 (ManualReview) is evaluated and triggered

cases.description: Fixed30 через явну фіксовану перевагу
Fixed30 через високу чутливість до ставки
ARM7/1: короткий горизонт + стабільний профіль

Конфлікт ARM7/1 vs Fixed (пріоритет → Fixed30)
Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Нейтральний сценарій (жодне правило не підходить)
Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference Priority
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate, which should trigger Fixed30 regardless of other factors.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity Priority
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity, triggering Fixed30.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Standard Success
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria for the 7/1 ARM.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Boundary Conditions
testSuite.description: Applicant meets the exact boundary conditions for ARM 7/1.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI ratio is above 50, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV ratio is above 95, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 vs Rule 2: Fixed Preference Overrides ARM
testSuite.description: Even if ARM criteria are met, Fixed preference takes precedence due to rule order.

testSuite.name: Rule 2 vs Rule 3: ARM Overrides Manual Review
testSuite.description: Even if Manual Review criteria (high DTI) are met, ARM takes precedence if it matches first.

testSuite.name: Rule 1 vs Rule 3: Fixed Preference Overrides Manual Review
testSuite.description: Even if Manual Review criteria (low credit) are met, Fixed preference takes precedence.
